card.name: Words leading into 'notable exception'
card.fires_on: Small words like a, the, one, few, or the word notable, right before a standout example or exception is named. Seen in general web prose after phrases like 'being', 'are', or 'with'.

modes.label: Article before exception
modes.description: A, the, or one that opens a phrase about an exception or standout case.

modes.label: Notable before exception
modes.description: The word notable itself, just before exception or exceptions.
modes.example: with the<< notable>> exceptions of the Nintendo 64 and

modes.label: Superlative setup
modes.description: The word the before most or only, singling out an extreme case.
modes.example: U.S. presidents are<< the>> only exception; they only need to be

card.writes: It pushes words that flag something as notable or prominent, such as notable, noteworthy, prominent and significant.
card.plain: It fires on small words that set up a standout example or exception, just before the text says what it is.
